verdict.rationale: Built-in physics is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions rigid bodies, collision detection, raycasts or any physics engine. The items only cover scripting, the CLI, plugins, import, licensing, networking and export, so the verdict must be none.
